contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES DOMIT AVG GERM PM TRP X ; R/ IMP XXI COS CENS PPP

Silver coin. Denarius of Domitian (81-96), as kindly identified by the finder, RIC vol. 2 page 172 no. 154, mint of Rome issue of 90-91. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, long neck. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES DOMIT AVG GERM PM TRP X. Reverse description: Draped figure [Minerva] standing left with curved shield propped, holding vertical spear, and thunderbolt diagonally to left. Reverse…
